newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: MALBAK RENEWS CAUTIONARY ON UNNAMED TALKS.
newsitem.headline: MALBAK RENEWS CAUTIONARY ON UNNAMED TALKS.

text.p: Packaging group Malbak Ltd on Thursday renewed a cautionary published on June 5, saying that the negotiations referred to in that announcement were continuing and may have an effect on the firm's share price.
It gave no further details in the brief announcement other than to advise shareholders to exercise caution in their share dealings.

South African financial markets have been abuzz in recent weeks on speculation that industrial conglomerate Rembrandt Group Ltd (Remgro) is set to buy Malbak through its Lenco Holdings Ltd unit. Lenco last month issued a cautionary announcement, saying it was in unspecified talks.
Remgro is due to release its annual results later on Thursday and market watchers are hoping it will make some comment on the rumoured talks.
